title: tuipresent deck front matter
description: The YAML block between the opening '---' (first line of the file) and the next line that is exactly '---'. Mirrors deck.Meta in internal/deck/deck.go. Unknown keys are ignored by the parser, so additionalProperties is true. See docs/agent/LANGUAGE.md section 2.

title.description: Deck title. When non-empty, a cover slide is inserted as slide 1 and the title appears in the footer.

sub_title.description: Italic line on the cover slide. Only shown when title is set (the cover exists only then).

author.description: Shown on the cover and in the footer as 'title  ·  author'.

date.description: Shown on the cover after the author as 'author  ·  date'. Free text; not parsed as a date.

theme.description: Color theme. A scalar name, or a mapping with a name. Accepted names and any further theme properties are defined by the theme system (being rewritten); extra mapping keys are currently ignored.
theme.$comment: TODO(themes): fill names and properties from the theme system.

transition.description: Default transition into every slide. The parser lowercases and trims the value and silently treats anything else as 'slide'; this schema only allows the five meaningful values so typos are caught.

fade.description: Pause-reveal fade for the whole deck. Disabled by false or by the strings 'false', 'off', 'no', 'none' (case-insensitive); any other value, or absence, leaves it on. A slide's <!-- fade: ... --> directive overrides it.

text.description: Any YAML scalar is accepted and used as its text (123 becomes "123"). Write a string. Sequences and mappings are a load error.
